items.title: Lowe's Stocks Fall 5.43% Premarket as Tariff Refund Masks Margin Squeeze
items.summary: Adjusted EPS of $3.10 included a $0.34 tariff refund, while gross margin narrowed to 32.95% from 34.19%.
